column2: Rather than become an $$邪神$$'s $$生けにえ$$, would you choose death by my hand?!
I don't care—kill the ones around them too, any way you like!!
P-please, spare me! I was only following orders!
Where do you think you're going?! Get back here and be a wall already!
I may look like this, but I'm a $$神官$$ too. If it comes to it, I'll use magic!
Heh. Even if you manage to escape from here...
Do you think $$逃亡奴隷$$s with $$羽$$ have anywhere safe to live?!
They committed the $$七つの大罪$$! They're the hideous minions of an $$邪神$$!!
Don't you prisoners get ideas above your station!
N-no way...! Why are scum like these so strong?!
Damn it, every last one of you... Then I'll show you what I'm really capable of!!
If we kill these bastards... maybe we can get out of here!
Those bastards won't live much longer anyway!!
Gah! Th-the $$死体$$s... They're moving on their own?!
